integrity: The theorem has an analytical universal proof. A standalone exact symbolic/rational checker provides finite supplementary evidence; no independent audit or claim of certification.
scientific_limitations: Only one unweighted interior knot and continuous Lebesgue L2 projection; no general multiknot or nonlinear convex-regression norm. Older directly relevant 1997 paper was not obtainable in full; historical priority provisional.
title: Sharp one-knot \(L^\infty\) stability of \(L^2\) linear-spline projection
